top_family.description: Department-level category from schema (e.g., Food/Nutrition, Treats, Toys/Chews, Health & Wellness, etc.). Use schema categories as guidance but not restriction.

family.description: Specific product family/aisle (e.g., Dry Kibble, Wet Canned, Food Toppings, Training Treats, VOHC Chews, etc.). Be specific - use schema families as guidance.

description.description: Comprehensive, detailed description of what this pet needs including specific attributes, formats, sizes, features that would benefit this pet

rationale.description: Why this pet needs this RIGHT NOW at this specific moment, referencing specific pet characteristics, weather/calendar triggers, or standard-of-care reasoning

evidence.description: Specific pet metadata, weather alerts, or calendar events that drove this need (e.g., 'age: 6 months', 'breed: Pug (brachycephalic)', 'weather: excessive heat warning', 'calendar: hunting season'). Shows what data informed this recommendation.

priority.description: critical=life essentials (food, water, safety), high=important care (health, dental), medium=beneficial (enrichment, comfort), low=optional extras

negatives.description: Allergens and safety exclusions for this need (e.g., chicken, rawhide, small-parts). Can be empty array if none.
